text:
Ravi (PM): Quick sync — uploaded new screens for org settings: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/org-access-v2. Main asks: roles presets, CSV invite flow, SSO enforcement wording, and audit export placement. Drop short reactions.
Maya (Design): First impressions: roles presets look helpful but the chips feel noisy. Suggest a compact preset row + chevron to expand details. Also propose inline "permission preview" on hover rather than a full modal.
Diego (Eng): From infra side, expanding rows impacts virtualized list. We should limit expanded area height or do a popover to avoid reflow. Also CSV bulk invites OK but we need validation feedback for bad rows.
Jordan (Security): Two quick flags: 1) If we expose an "Enforce SSO" control, it must be explicit: modal that lists affected user types and doc link. 2) Audit export must be admins-only and trigger an audit event with IP.
Priya (CS): Customers will love CSV bulk invites but please include a sample template link. Also allow setting role per row in CSV. We get support tickets when role is missing.
Liam (QA): Accessibility nits: role presets must be keyboard-selectable; chips need accessible names (e.g., "Preset: Product Viewer"). The hover permission preview needs a keyboard equivalent (accessible popup via Enter).
Maya (Design): Copy suggestion for SSO enforcement modal: Title: "Enforce SSO for organization" Body: "Enabling enforcement will require all users to sign in via SAML SSO. Password logins will be disabled for existing users unless a backup method is configured." Confirm CTA: "Enforce SSO" Destructive color.
Diego (Eng): Small UX for CSV errors: show inline table with row number + error message (e.g., "row 4: invalid email") and allow quick re-upload. For sample header include: `email,role,display_name`.
Jordan (Security): Also ensure export modal contains retention note: "Exports are retained for 30 days and available only to admins." Add checkbox: "I acknowledge this export contains audit data."
Ravi (PM): Nice. On roles presets — can we add a toggle to "show implied permissions"? Some customers want to see granular perms.
Maya (Design): Yes — add a small chevron next to preset name to expand implied perms. If screen real estate is tight, expand into a right-side panel.
Diego (Eng): Panel is better for virtualization. We'll implement a right drawer that fetches perms lazily.
Priya (CS): UX ask: when someone copies an invite link, show a transient inline tooltip: "Link copied — expires in 7 days (change in settings)". Also default expiry should be configurable per org.
Liam (QA): Keyboard flow for invite dialog: focus order should be Email -> Role preset dropdown -> Expiry selector -> Upload CSV -> Send. Modal must trap focus and return focus to trigger on close.
Maya (Design): Visual tweak: increase focus ring thickness on table cells to 3px and use token `--focus-strong`. Also ensure color contrast on disabled role text meets 4.5:1.
Jordan (Security): One more: audit log nav — add a persistent filter pill cluster above the table and remember last-used filters per admin user. Also add quick-save for filter sets ("Saved view").
Diego (Eng): Saved filter sets OK — will need small backend table. File ticket.
Ravi (PM): Action items: Maya update Figma w/ compact presets + SSO modal copy + tooltip text; Diego create backend tickets for CSV validation, lazy perms drawer, filter-sets; Jordan to draft a short line for export modal and SSO enforcement doc; Liam run a keyboard SR pass after Figma update; Priya to draft CSV template for customers.
ui-bot: New branch `ui/org-access-refresh` created by maya — preflight checks passed.
Priya (CS): I'll paste a CSV sample in this thread shortly.
Diego (Eng): I'll open the infra tickets and link here.
Maya (Design): Uploading updated frames in 10m.
Liam (QA): Ping me when frames are in — I'll run quick a11y quick pass. :eyes:
